description.value: The study examined functional and structural brain responses to food images in women with acquired hypoleptinemia before and after metreleptin treatment, compared with healthy normoleptinemic controls.

spans.text: Thus, we sought to study whether, similar to congenital leptin deficiency, structural changes may also occur in response to acquired leptin deficiency and how leptin replacement may alter brain activation in response to viewing food images in patients who have an acquired leptin deficiency.
